peg.peg_mechanism_score_basis: USDS combines a zero-fee USDC LitePSM, one-for-one DAI conversion and overcollateralized vault debt. The latest oracle mark was $0.999934. The mechanism is strong, but its strongest rail is also its largest single-asset dependency.
peg.peg_mechanism_score_persistence: Recheck after a material peg event, PSM fee or inventory change, or break in DAI parity.

backing.backing_score_basis: USDS plus DAI supply was $11.683B and reported backing was $11.750B. The relevant health signal, the vow surplus buffer, remained negative at $52.3M or 0.45% of supply. The deficit did not clear; current backing remains concentrated in stablecoins and onchain crypto lending.
backing.backing_score_persistence: Recheck on a buffer sign change, material allocator shift, loss event or look-through methodology change.

liquidity.liquidity_score_basis: The LitePSM held $4.354B USDC with zero tin and tout, and USDS retains DAI parity. The routed $1M-$50M ladder is not size-responsive, so $50M is a probe rather than measured depth. The score rests on fixed-rate rails and timestamped inventory, not DEX depth.
liquidity.liquidity_score_persistence: Recheck PSM inventory, fees, caps, DAI parity and chain-local exits.

dependencies.underlying_score_basis: Vat-debt shares were Sky core 44.78%, Spark 31.51%, Grove 14.67% and Obex 3.47%; Spark plus Grove were 46.18%. Raw USDC was 38.36%. USDS remains broader than Grove alone, while allocator and USDC concentration remain material and the crypto-lending collateral set is unresolved.
dependencies.underlying_score_persistence: Recheck allocator shares, USDC concentration and upstream report quality.

issuer.issuer_score_basis: Sky/Maker has a long operating history and public, reviewable governance and delegation, providing greater operating accountability than an opaque single operator. Retain Issuer 7.0 provisionally: protocol operating continuity is distinct from unresolved token-specific corporate payout, current reserve title/beneficiary/enforcement and insolvency/shutdown rights. Skybase is an interface counterparty and Sky Frontier Foundation disclaims issuing/redemption/custody/guarantees; neither is substituted as repayment obligor. Complete registrations/controllers, signed protocol-wide assurance and comprehensive conduct history remain unestablished. Governance discretion and allocator/vehicle complexity constrain the assessment. No score credit here for code audits, bounty size, universal 48h control or fresh security verification.
issuer.issuer_score_persistence: Reassess each claim on new legal/vehicle/assurance or verified governance/conduct evidence; shared numeric marks are not automatic propagation.
